lines.text: Let us practise some easier ones.
Read the cursive word. Tap the printed word that matches.
Spell bus. Trace each letter of bus.
Spell car. Look at it and remember it.
Spell cone. Trace each letter of cone.
Spell rock. Trace each letter of rock.
Trace the letter Y. Y is for yarn.
Try to stay on the dots. Tap the drop to start over.
Try to stay on the line. Tap the drop to start over.
Write mountain. We climbed the mountain. mountain.
Write the short form of chapter.
Write the word that means: Ten years.
Write this sentence. If they win, it's a record.
